crossRefs.note: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;
They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are…
Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning…
“ ‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your…
The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as…
You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
“You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
Jesus answered, “The greatest is, ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:
Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be…
For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do…

translations.web: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
translations.bsb: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
translations.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
translations.asv: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.
